props.name: fullWidth
props.type: | boolean | { narrow?: boolean regular?: boolean wide?: boolean }
props.description: Whether the control fills the width of its parent

props.name: onChange
props.description: The handler that gets called when a segment is selected

props.name: variant
props.description: Configure the control's visual treatment or responsive behavior in tight spaces.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: The leading visual comes before item label

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Deprecated: use `leadingVisual` instead. The leading icon comes before item label.

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether the segment is selected. This is used for controlled SegmentedControls, and needs to be updated using the onChange handler on SegmentedControl.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Whether the segment is selected. This is used for uncontrolled SegmentedControls to pick one SegmentedControlButton that is selected on the initial render.

props.name: count
props.description: The number to display in the counter label.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon that represents the segmented control item

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether the segment is selected. This is used for controlled SegmentedControls, and needs to be updated using the onChange handler on SegmentedControl.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Whether the segment is selected. This is used for uncontrolled SegmentedControls to pick one SegmentedControlButton that is selected on the initial render.

props.name: description
props.description: If `description` is provided, we will use a Tooltip to describe the button. Then `aria-label` is used to label the button.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the action icon button.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon rendered by the action button.

props.name: onClick
props.description: The handler that gets called when the action button is clicked.

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the action is in a loading state.
